findings.source_quote: “Will he be in church on Sunday?” interjected Dirk, stopping the travels of his tractor in his concern to hear the answer.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect vehicle word with the faithful rendering of the source. For example, change “trok” to “trekker” or “traktor” so the sentence reads: “…en die reis van sy trekker/traktor gestop omdat hy die antwoord wil hoor.” Preserve punctuation and HTML structure.
